maps.title: Lantern & Larch Inn
maps.description: A furnished roadside inn with a hearth, kitchen and storeroom. Warm firelight meets afternoon window light.

maps.title: Briarwood Crossroads
maps.description: Forest paths, a stalled cart and a sheltered camp. Moonlight threads through the canopy.

maps.title: Moonwater Bridge
maps.description: A narrow crossing above a moonlit river, with broken ruins and clear ambush approaches.

maps.title: Mossfall Chapel
maps.description: A fallen chapel with surviving columns, broken walls and an open eastern approach.

maps.title: Echoing Caverns
maps.description: A broad limestone chamber with a deep pool, mineral outcrops and open tactical space.

maps.title: Ironbarrow Crypt
maps.description: A burial hall, side tombs and an altar chamber. Wall braziers cast long shadows across the pillars.

maps.title: Oldwatch Keep
maps.description: A fortified courtyard, gatehouse and barracks ready for a siege or a tense arrival.

maps.title: Saltwind Docks
maps.description: Warehouse doors, cargo stacks and long piers beside a cold harbour.

maps.title: Emberforge Mine
maps.description: A working mine with a forge, rail cart and branching tunnels. Furnace light mixes with cool ore crystals.

maps.title: Ashen Cellblock
maps.description: Six prison cells, a guard room and barred windows. A strong showcase for door occlusion and 60-foot darkvision.

maps.title: Willowfen Ruins
maps.description: Boardwalks cross dark marsh water toward a broken shrine and standing stones.

maps.title: Sunspire Sanctum
maps.description: A broad temple nave with a central aisle and three high windows. Strong, warm shafts break around the columns.

maps.title: Frostpass Ambush
maps.description: A winding snowy pass, broken wagon and exposed campsite beneath an icy moon.

maps.title: Market of Lanterns
maps.description: An evening market with striped stalls, a fountain and many approach routes.

maps.title: Red Sail Sloop
maps.description: A compact ship deck with a captain’s cabin, mast, cargo and a lantern-lit boarding approach.
